BUILT LINKED #gin-sear-decode-constraint as of 2026-10-04

GIN's SEAR layer constrains every generated token, at decode time, to continue a span that occurs verbatim in the retrieved corpus, using a custom llama-cpp-python logits processor.

Does not showThat the constrained output is correct or fair to its source. Verbatim spans can still be selected or juxtaposed misleadingly. It also does not show behaviour on native Windows: the repo notes the generation path is only exercised under Linux/WSL.

BUILT LINKED #sear-demo-pipeline as of 2026-10-09

sear-demo is a corpus-grounded answer pipeline with a verification gate: the model writes freely, then each claim must be entailed by its cited chunk (NLI) and every name and number must appear in it, or the claim is dropped; an explicit failure state replaces guessing.

Does not showDecode-time constraint: this is SEAR's verify-after stage, not GIN's decode-time mask. Verified is not true: the gate enforces the corpus, not the world (see sear-poisoned-fork).

BUILT LINKED #receipts-pipeline as of 2026-10-01
